line: e4 d5 exd5 Qxd5 Nc3 Qd8 d4 c6 Nf3 Bg4 Bc4
teaches: Against a system whose whole point is solidity, there is nothing clever to find — occupy the centre, develop toward their weakest point, and let the extra space do the arguing. A setup that retreats the queen all the way home has conceded time, and time is only collected by moves that do something.
explains: The bishop takes the diagonal aiming straight at f7, the one square a retreated-queen setup has not reinforced, with the centre already occupied behind it. Every move so far has been a piece coming out to a square it wants.
